semiconductor_relevance: High — Daikin Chemical India specializes in advanced cleaning systems and fluorochemical solutions specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Daikin Chemical India offers innovative cleaning equipment and fluorochemical products that enhance the efficiency and quality of semiconductor manufacturing. Their 'X-FORM' cleaning system is designed for both single wafer and batch processing, while their fluorochemical solutions provide essential properties for semiconductor applications.
capabilities: X-FORM Semiconductor & MEMS Cleaner for 200mm & 300mm wafers
DUPRA (FFKM) for ultra-cleanliness and heat resistance
TRC Series for purity and static removal
ULSHEED coatings for durability and low metal contamination

regional_presence.India: Daikin Chemical India operates within the Indian market, focusing on providing advanced solutions for semiconductor manufacturing.
